subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. Jane and Roberta flew together before the ship, and Roberta has had two glasses of the still's best and decided the table should know it. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads.
